definitions: To form a line; to fall into line.
To adjust to a line; to range or form in line; to bring into line.

blocks.text: Halifax is an American pop-punk band from Thousand Oaks, California. They formed in 2003 and are currently unsigned. Their 2004 EP A Writer's Reference has sold over 60,000 copies to date, after making a cameo appearance on MTV's The Real World: Austin. The band's second full-length album, The Inevitability of a Strange World, was released in May 2006 and charted on the Billboard 200 and debuted at number 1 on the Billboard Heatseekers. They also won MTV2's Dew Circuit Breakout competition later that year.
